handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created migrations/001_init_schema.sql with complete database schema for LLM evaluation backend. Tables include: evaluations (task records with status tracking, UUID id, JSONB config, timestamp fields with auto-update triggers), models (CHECK constraints on type IN ('api','local') and provider IN ('openai','anthropic','dashscope','qwen','custom')), datasets (evaluation dataset definitions), results (JSONB metrics, foreign key to evaluations), predictions (per-sample predictions with foreign keys and NOT NULL constraints), logs (execution logs with JSONB metadata). Implemented triggers for automatic updated_at timestamps and status transition timestamps (started_at on 'running', completed_at on terminal states). Pre-populated 9 default models (GPT-4, Claude, Qwen variants) and 5 datasets (MMLU, HellaSwag, HumanEval, GSM8K, C-Eval).
